corrections.claim: A failed direct documentation fetch or literal HTML search proves unsupported syntax.
corrections.correction: Direct urllib requests returned HTTP 403 for four documentation pages after ctx_fetch_and_index had retrieved them successfully. Joining separated HTML text nodes hid npm's exact syntax; preserving adjacent text nodes recovered <name>@<version>. These were retrieval/processing failures, not capability absences.

corrections.claim: A single filesystem existence pass can validate every evidence_refs item.
corrections.correction: The first local observation treated HTTPS citations as files and falsely listed them as missing. The corrected observation distinguishes HTTPS references from repository paths: all 24 local references exist. No profile gap was removed or added from the erroneous pass.
corrections.verification: independent_observation.missing_local_evidence_files is empty; install table coverage is also complete.
